root_cause: No tree-aware reveal operation existed: nothing walked ancestor viewports or computed getOffsetToReveal.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/ensure_visible.rs (new: Scrollable::ensure_visible(&WidgetTree, ElementId, EnsureVisible) walks enclosing Scroll/SliverViewport renders innermost first; offset = leading - (viewport - target) * alignment, leading measured from the far side on reversed axes, clamped to range; keep-visible policies move only toward their edge and swap on reversed axes; the outer viewports reveal the first target clipped to the inner object's size; all targets are computed from pre-scroll geometry, then each viewport jumps or animate_to(duration, curve)); scrolling.rs and lib.rs exports; README paragraph
api_change: additive: EnsureVisible (alignment/duration/curve/alignment_policy builders, Flutter defaults 0.0/zero/Curves.ease/explicit), ScrollPositionAlignmentPolicy {Explicit, KeepVisibleAtEnd, KeepVisibleAtStart}, Scrollable::ensure_visible
limitations: Entry point takes &WidgetTree + ElementId (no BuildContext path for app callbacks); pinned slivers do not shrink the reveal extent (Flutter maxScrollObstructionExtentBefore and the infinite pinned-target result are not ported); wheel, two-dimensional and sheet scrollables are not walked; min scroll extent assumed 0; returns a moved-viewport count, not a future.

root_cause: Sliver viewports had no paintOrder: layers and hit order were hard-coded as flow children first to last with pinned/floating overlays lifted on top, which is neither Flutter order.

harness: slivers__: 15 of 16 match (only the known slivers-004 keep-alive rect residual diverges); no paint-order twin exists
api_change: additive builder CustomScrollView::paint_order / Viewport::paint_order and the SliverPaintOrder enum. Behavior change: under the default FirstIsTop, a pinned or floating header placed after earlier slivers no longer jumps above them (Flutter behavior). A leading header stays on top.
limitations: SliverMainAxisGroup children keep first-to-last order (Flutter's group paints them last to first); semantics child order is unchanged (Flutter visits semantics in paint order); there is no pixel scene.
